summary.value: On a rest, set a condition describing a creature.

system.description: On a rest, set a condition describing a creature. When such a creature tries to enter your Sanctuary: you know, wherever you are, and it must beat you in an Opposed (WLP + WLP) Check — you at +(SL × 2) — or be repelled until sunrise. Once per creature per night; a Villain may spend 1 Ultima Point to force through.
